subject.title: feat(android): Talk camera flip control and microphone selection

question: Should persistent per-device camera and microphone selection remain an Android Talk product surface once the core capture contract and on-device behavior are proven?
rationale: This PR adds durable user-facing controls and persisted preferences; the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit maintainer decision beyond routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor the Android preferences
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the core omitted-facing repair and real-device proof, then review the completed behavior.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain only the control whose end-to-end Android behavior and ownership can be demonstrated without expanding the current Talk surface.

options.title: Defer the product surface
options.body: Pause the PR if persistent camera and microphone preferences are not intended for Android Talk at this time.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Android preferences
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the core omitted-facing repair and real-device proof, then review the completed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the person most directly connected to the proposed Android Talk behavior; confidence is limited because current-main area history could not be inspected.
